The '''Enforcer''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron Enforcer was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with patch 4.5 and is available from Revenge Alliance Pack.
